brief:
More than 500 activists representing 20 countries converged in Diyarbakır province in southeastern Turkey to demonstrate solidarity with the Palestinian people and reject Israeli military operations, the Shehab Wire reported. The gathering took place as part of the "Palestine Convoy," an international initiative that originated in Srebrenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and traveled across multiple nations to mobilize cross-border support.

The convoy brought together participants from diverse geographic and cultural backgrounds in a coordinated show of opposition to what organizers described as Israeli aggression. The assembly in Diyarbakır marked a significant waypoint in the convoy's journey to unite activists around Palestinian causes and amplify their voices on the international stage.
title: Over 500 activists from 20 countries rally for Palestine in Turkey
